readings: Compute the overall average HGB across all nonmissing Laboratory.HGB records. For each patient with at least one nonmissing HGB record, compute their average HGB. Among patients whose average exceeds the overall record average, list the patient ID, their average HGB, the difference from the overall record average, and the difference from the average of the qualifying patients’ average HGB values. Return the top 10 by the last difference, highest first, breaking ties by patient ID ascending. Do not round.

Compute each patient’s average HGB from their nonmissing Laboratory.HGB records, excluding patients with no nonmissing HGB records. Compute the overall average as the unweighted average of those patient averages. Among patients whose average exceeds that overall average, list the patient ID, their average HGB, the difference from the overall average, and the difference from the average of the qualifying patients’ average HGB values. Return the top 10 by the last difference, highest first, breaking ties by patient ID ascending. Do not round.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_hgb
)
SELECT
    q.ID,
    q.avg_hgb,
    q.avg_hgb - o.avg_hgb AS difference_from_overall,
    q.avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM qualifying) AS difference_from_qualifying_average
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
ORDER BY difference_from_qualifying_average DESC, q.ID ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS overall_average
    FROM patient_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, o.overall_average
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.average_hgb > o.overall_average
),
qualifying_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_hgb) AS average_hgb
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT
    q.ID,
    q.average_hgb,
    q.average_hgb - q.overall_average AS difference_from_overall,
    q.average_hgb - a.average_hgb AS difference_from_qualifying_average
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_average AS a
ORDER BY difference_from_qualifying_average DESC, q.ID ASC
LIMIT 10
